description: This file defines API routes for managing requirements in a FastAPI web application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, fetching, updating, and deleting requirement records from a database using SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: Requirement _get_requirement_or_404(db: Session, requirement_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a Requirement object by ID or raises a 404 HTTPException if not found.

methods.name: List[Requirement] list_requirements(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all requirements.

methods.name: Requirement create_requirement(payload: RequirementCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new requirement.

methods.name: Requirement get_requirement(requirement_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a requirement by ID.

methods.name: Requirement update_requirement( requirement_id: int, payload: RequirementUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update an existing requirement.

methods.name: None delete_requirement(requirement_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a requirement by ID.

ctags.pattern: /^def create_requirement(payload: RequirementCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> Requirement/

ctags.pattern: /^def delete_requirement(requirement_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> None:$/

ctags.name: get_requirement
ctags.pattern: /^def get_requirement(requirement_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> Requirement:$/

ctags.signature: ( requirement_id: int, payload: RequirementUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
